items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in business administration or liberal arts is preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

A minimum of 2 years of administrative experience with increasing responsibility is preferred. At least 2 years of experience at an academic institution is preferred. At least 2 years of data collection and analysis experience preferred.
Coordinate scheduling of fellowships events, meetings, and interview sessions, including posting events in Handshake, room reservations, and catering.
Collect, collate, and distribute fellowship applicant files, using Outlook, Sakai, SurveyMonkey Apply, and various fellowships application platforms.
Coordinate the on-campus review process for Fulbright applicants.
Upload Campus Committee Evaluations to the Fulbright application portal.
Process travel and other payments for the Pomona-Downing and Downing-Pomona scholars.
Maintain organized and efficient storage of electronic files on internal Fellowships drives.
Assist with maintenance of Fellowships Advising webpages.
Organize presentations by visitors from fellowships foundations.
